::: callout-note
Zenodo's terms can sometimes be a bit confusing. The two main terms are:

- Deposit: A Zenodo deposit is the set of files and metadata that will
  eventually form a published record. For a given output (e.g. an academic
  paper), there is only one deposit. However, the information contained in a
  deposit can still be updated or changed.
- Record: A Zenodo record is a published set of files and metadata with a
  specific DOI. There can be multiple records for any given deposit. A record is
  something you can't change. This is sometimes called "version".
:::
